title: Geist
subtitle: A scientist separated from his body
summary: Geist is n-Space's action adventure, first released for GameCube in North America on 15 August 2005.
body: Geist is n-Space's action adventure, first released for GameCube in North America on 15 August 2005. Scientist John Raimi is captured during an investigation and separated from his body. As a spirit, he searches the Volks Corporation's facilities for a way back. Possession connects its puzzles and first-person combat: the next useful ability belongs to something or someone Raimi must first find a way to inhabit.

Objects provide a means of affecting the physical world. Raimi can animate or alter them to frighten a person or animal, making that creature vulnerable to possession. A guard may supply a weapon and access to another room; a smaller animal may reach a narrow opening. Looking around therefore means considering potential hosts as well as doors and enemies.

Leaving a host changes the pace and appearance of the surrounding world, but Raimi cannot remain unattached indefinitely. Another possession anchors him again and supplies a different set of abilities. The player repeatedly shifts between observing a situation as a ghost and acting through a borrowed body. That change of viewpoint gives an ordinary room several possible routes, depending on whose senses and movements are available.
story_headings: A scientist separated from his body
Frighten a host to find a way forward
Borrow another view of the world
